## 行程

* [麻布台 Hills](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Azabudai+Hills/@35.6615447,139.7386415,17z/data=!3m1!5s0x60188b998ef5c6e5:0xa699b8bd11c190a9!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188b2e40342225:0x3f9a1673138a69c1!8m2!3d35.6615447!4d139.7408302!16s%2Fg%2F11jdgqhr5t?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
* [森美術館](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Mori+Art+Museum/@35.6604621,139.7205238,15z/data=!3m1!5s0x60188b770968fbdd:0xade6fa826b6e383d!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188b770f429483:0xff33d131dc8d6e9!8m2!3d35.6604621!4d139.7292785!16s%2Fm%2F0g5t56r?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) **(10am - 5pm)**
  * *位於六本木 Hills 53 樓*
* [teamLab Borderless](https://www.google.com/maps/place/teamLab+Borderless:+MORI+Building+DIGITAL+ART+MUSEUM/@35.6609263,139.7404046,17z/data=!3m1!5s0x60188b9741cfc0d3:0xc91c5c5975739ded!4m6!3m5!1s0x601889fad49a9443:0x5831aba3288d2651!8m2!3d35.6620689!4d139.7432671!16s%2Fg%2F11ggvtjmjl?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) 數位藝術美術館（建議提前預約門票）(8:30am - 9pm)
* [六本木 Hills](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Roppongi+Hills/@35.6607397,139.7292319,17z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188b771049dc33:0x5bfe0248594cc802!8m2!3d35.6607397!4d139.7292319!16zL20vMDFyMl9r?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) 展望台: 欣賞包含東京鐵塔與東京市區的經典絕美夜景。
* [國立新美術館](https://www.google.com/maps/place/The+National+Art+Center,+Tokyo/@35.665289,139.726374,16z/data=!3m1!5s0x60188b7bfbdbd741:0x73a424664f5d6042!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188b7bf6ceeb3f:0x4025f2eaf2aa9d18!8m2!3d35.665289!4d139.726374!16s%2Fm%2F027tlcf?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D): 由黑川紀章設計，擁有波浪狀玻璃外牆與優雅展覽空間。 
  * 10am - 6pm, **週二公休**
* [芝公園](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Shibakoen,+Minato+City,+Tokyo+105-0011,+Japan/@35.6576179,139.748107,16z/data=!4m6!3m5!1s0x60188bbe9029c3ff:0x6b5cf959a2346d3f!8m2!3d35.6571637!4d139.7485979!16s%2Fg%2F1pxy8r4rx?entry=tts&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxMi4wIPu8ASoASAFQAw%3D%3D&skid=9cc8686f-ff0e-4e56-abfa-7d9b0cc5f62b)散步捕捉東京鐵塔點燈夜景。
* [東京鐵塔](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Tokyo+Tower/@35.6585805,139.7454329,17z/data=!4m14!1m7!3m6!1s0x60188bbd9009ec09:0x481a93f0d2a409dd!2sTokyo+Tower!8m2!3d35.6585805!4d139.7454329!16zL20vMDEzMl94!3m5!1s0x60188bbd9009ec09:0x481a93f0d2a409dd!8m2!3d35.6585805!4d139.7454329!16zL20vMDEzMl94?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDgxNy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D)
